_comment: PRE-REGISTERED single-shot baseline input. Gold for these claims was committed to git before this file was handed to any model. Claim statements only.
question: For each claim, give its epistemic status AFTER discarding all experiments by the retracted author group (Shu et al. 2012). SUPPORTED, REFUTED, or UNRESOLVED.

claims.claim: Signing a veracity statement at the beginning rather than the end of a self-report form significantly reduces dishonesty.
Signing before rather than after the opportunity to cheat makes ethics salient when they are needed most.
The adoption of signing-first by government agencies is warranted by the evidence.
Signing order has no effect on honest reporting.
